scope: Be Yours:Sheen official preset listing demo inspected read-only via rendered browser accessibility trees. No shopper actions, screenshot, viewport, mobile, editor, checkout or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Be Yours Sheen preset listing View demo opened the Be Yours clothing demo storefront.

claims.observed: Home presents seasonal and campaign modules with category paths and Shop the Look; collection offers color, size, price and brand facets; PDP exposes size help, variant choices and sticky cart content.
claims.risk: Rendered affordances do not prove filter, quick-view, variant, sticky-cart or pickup behavior, and the demo content may not match a real merchant catalog.
claims.vsn_guard: Test collection controls and PDP fit guidance in shopper flows; keep campaign destinations consistent with their product assortment.

claims.observed: Demo displays discount prices, countdown and low-stock copy, customer ratings, free-shipping/returns and pickup or delivery statements.
claims.risk: Visible sample content is not evidence that discounts, inventory, ratings, fulfillment options or return terms are accurate.
claims.vsn_guard: Bind promo and stock messages to authoritative data, and verify reviews, delivery and return terms before exposing them.
